ENG-Video\\X01 patch_MissionInfo.tbd.original:
The first nexus subject is Diego Angelus.  He was the eldest of the three sons of Rimtech's legendary Icarus Angelus. Driven by his strong personal ambition, devotion to Rimtech, and sense of family honor, Diego had quickly advanced through the ranks.  

Following the Mil-Agro attack and the disappearance of Jonus and Stefan, the CorpoNation Alliance began to unravel.  Rimtech became concerned about other CorpoNations encroaching on its territories.  The Chief Tactical Officer, CTO Hansen, ordered all Rimtech forces to combat alert and distributed new orders to field commanders.

Diego's tasks were rather simple.  He was tightbeamed to a different sector of Hedoth Prime to erect a base that contained a combot Parts Factory and Assembly Bay.  Once operational, Diego needed to construct two combots to guard the base.
ENG-Video\\X01 patch_MissionInfo.tbd.translated: O primeiro sujeito nexus e Diego Angelus. O mais velho dos tres filhos do lendario fundador da Rimtech, Icaro Angelus. Sua devolucao a corporacao o fez ascender rapidamente.

A former testing ground used by the Eastern Sun Alliance to practice war games, now used by Neuropa to train and evaluate commander candidates.

Limited land obstacles and great underground resources make this an excellent 2-3 player ground warfare map. 

Battlefield created by the CorpoNations to decide inter-CorpoNation land disputes before the Battle of Hedoth began. Each CorpoNation would pit their best crew or crews against one another and the winning CorpoNation would claim the land without any further disputes from the loser.
M3_08\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
PLANICES INFRUTIFERAS
Obstaculos terrestres limitados e grandes recursos subterraneos fazem destas planices excelente campo para combate rapido.

M4_11\\gobjects.tbd.original:
FLINN'S RIDGE
Desert region with 4 lava-rich plateaus overlooking a large, barren valley.  Underground resources are somewhat scarce except for the high concentration of metajoules found in the center of the map.

The most dreaded assignment for any Mil-Agro recruit is Flinn's Ridge.  Flinn's Ridge average daily temperature ranges between 110 to 150 degrees.  Mil-Agro established a communications depot in the region prior to the war, due to it's excellent position sandwiched between their two largest trade routes
M4_11\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
CRISTA DE FLINN
Regiao desertica com 4 platos ricos em lava com vista para um grande vale arido. Posicoes elevadas oferecem vantagem tatica.

M4_12\\gobjects.tbd.original:
TANNHAUSER GATE
A hot, humid region with a high concentration of metajoules in the center of the valley atop a large plateau.  The multiple asteroids provide plenty of space to collect solar energy in orbit.

A Mil-Agro strikeforce came across this area completely by accident after their dropship's navigational computer malfunctioned.  They were supposed to help reinforce a Mil-Agro base that was under attack on the far side of the planet.  When they finally arrived at their planned destination, it was too late.  Neuropa had overrun the base and taken no prisoners.  The newly arrived strikeforce were no exception.
M4_12\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
PORTAO DE TANNHAUSER
Regiao quente e umida com alta concentracao de metajoules nos pocos de lava centrais. Quem controlar o centro vence.

M4_15\\gobjects.tbd.original:
DUNES OF AMBER
High, complex ridges line the lava rich plains of this desert region.  Underground resources are also abundant.

The battle that Rimtech prepared for in this desolate location was perhaps the largest battle that never took place.  Rimtech intercepted data that indicated Mil-Agro had been developing a secret weapon in the region with 20+ Combot divisions guarding it.  Rimtech sent thirty-two Combot divisions with their three best generals only to find an empty desert.  The real battle was taking place in an equally remote area of Hedoth Prime were Rimtech forces were severely outnumbered, yet prevailed behind the bold leadership of Corporal Reardon.
M4_15\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
DUNAS DE AMBAR
Altas cristas complexas margeiam as planices ricas em lava desta regiao desertica. O subsolo esconde depositos ainda maiores.

M6_19\\gobjects.tbd.original:
VALLEY OF THE DAMNED
Battlefield set atop a high plateau with numerous ridges separating each side.  Surface and underground resources are adequate for a short time, so solar energy should receive a lot of attention for a lengthy battle.  Great map for Allies - Player 1 and 2 vs. Player 3 and 4 vs. Player 5 and 6.

Located in a remote region of Taligra 2, this desert marks the graveyard of over 400 Mil-Agro troops who died of starvation.  Apparently, the record kept of the entire operation was accidentally destroyed, so supply ships were never informed that they were supposed to re-equip the site every 3 months.

VALE DOS CONDENADOS

M6_20\\gobjects.tbd.original:

M8_22\\gobjects.tbd.original:
FORTRESS OF RUIN
Large alien city build around a large, centralized maze containing a very rich lava pool.  

Alien city that earned it's name for the three major three-way battles that took place between Rimtech, Mil-Agro and Neuropa during the Battle for Hedoth III.  The first battle, known as "Aidan's Frenzy," lasted ten days until Rimtech and Neuropa Forces were finally overwhelmed by Mil-Agro reinforcements.  The second battle ended with Rimtech reclaiming the zone until the third battle erupted five days later with Neuropa coming out on top.
M8_22\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
FORTALEZA DA RUINA
Grande cidade alien construida ao redor de uma grande estrutura centralizada. Recursos abundantes para quem controlar o centro.

M8_23\\gobjects.tbd.original:
PLAINS OF DECEMBER
The enhancer is in a tough position - the central asteroid in orbit. Getting there is half the battle.

When a Rimtech mineral team discovered a Hedoth structure on this planet, they immediately notified Basecomm.  Unfortunately, a Neuropa supply ship intercepted the signal and alerted it's own forces as well.  The two armies arrived almost simultaneously and erupted into a huge, disorganized battle that left both sides devastated.  When the Mil-Agro Skyhawks swooped in to clean up the remains, they faced almost no resistance.
M8_23\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
PLANICES DE DEZEMBRO
O intensificador esta no asteroide central em orbita. Guerrear em tres camadas simultaneamente sera essencial para vencer.

M8_24\\gobjects.tbd.original:
ENIGMAS OF IRON
Alien city cramped with a complex system of walls and pillars.  Ground attacks may prove difficult to coordinate, but the orbit and underground are very accessible.

When General Wynkoop of Rimtech gave the attack order, he had no idea he was firing on his own troops.  "The bizarre, winding, alien structures were enough to disorient anyone," his attorney argued to the council.  General Wynkoop was found guilty by the council and dishonorably discharged.
M8_24\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
ENIGMAS DE FERRO
Cidade alien abarrotada de paredes e pilares formando labirintos. Unidades terrestres terao dificuldades, mas os recursos sao abundantes.

M8_25\\gobjects.tbd.original:
RIVERS RUN DRY 
Large desert region with ample resources and flat ground for waging large ground offensives. 

One of the largest land battles of the war took place in this desert. It also marked the first occasion where Rimtech and Neuropa forces temporarily allied with each other to fight off an overwhelming Mil-Agro army. The alliance, however, wasn't enough as the Mil-Agro armies were just too numerous and tenacious to overcome.
M8_25\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
RIOS SECOS
Grande regiao desertica com amplos recursos e terreno plano, ideal para operacoes militares em larga escala sem impedimentos geograficos.

A malfunctioning alien combot stands idle atop the center plateau guarded by alien tanks.  A player who could capture and research this alien robot could become very powerful.

Foolishly, the Colonel underestimated the strength of the alien tanks and ordered his squad to secure the area.  The Colonel and his squad werte never heard from again.

X_01\\gobjects.tbd.original:
The first nexus subject is Diego Angelus.  He was the eldest of the three sons of Rimtech's legendary Icarus Angelus. Driven by his strong personal ambition, devotion to Rimtech, and sense of family honor, Diego had quickly advanced through the ranks.  

Following the Mil-Agro attack and the disappearance of Jonus and Stefan, the CorpoNation Alliance began to unravel.  Rimtech became concerned about other CorpoNations encroaching on its territories.  The Chief Tactical Officer, CTO Hansen, ordered all Rimtech forces to combat alert and distributed new orders to field commanders.

Diego's tasks were rather simple.  He was tightbeamed to a different sector of Hedoth Prime to erect a base that contained a combot Parts Factory and Assembly Bay.  Once operational, Diego needed to construct two combots to guard the base.
X_01\\gobjects.tbd.translated: O primeiro sujeito nexus e Diego Angelus. O mais velho dos tres filhos do lendario fundador da Rimtech, Icaro Angelus. Sua devolucao a corporacao o fez ascender rapidamente.

X_01\\gobjects.tbd.original:
Personal log: Angelus, Diego, Serial # RT1654-CTL7
Entry: 2295-087

New orders forced me to break off the search for my brothers.  I found the wreckage of Stefan's combot almost immediately, but there was no sign of him.  No body.  No tracks.  Maybe someone found him? I wish I knew.

Entry: 2295-089

The morale of my staff is pretty low.  No one wants to believe Jonus would be stupid enough to join those fanatics at Neuropa, but we all seem to think that's just what he did.  Given the poor spirits, I can't believe CTO Hansen is sending us on a milk-run like this.  Any competent combot crew could handle this mission, but instead they send someone with my rank to do it.  My staff and I feel like we're being punished for letting Jonus get away with that alien arm.  Three months ago they were betting I'd be shooting for the CTO position within a year.  No one's talking like that now.
X_01\\gobjects.tbd.translated:

Responding to reports of further Mil-Agro raids, Diego was sent to establish the defenses of a Rimtech archaeology station.  Its remoteness from suitable landing sites made extending the defense grid to it a challenge.

In Diego's favor was that he had been given the opportunity to upgrade the neural implants of his staff, and that he had been assigned one of Rimtech's top pilots, Issadora Toltec, as his new second in command.

X_02\\gobjects.tbd.original:
Issadora Toltec proved her worth in that first mission.  She was as talented and resourceful as her reputation had indicated, but her assignment to Diego would ultimately have repercussions none could foresee.

Diego's battle near the archeology station provided evidence that Neuropa was violating the CorpoNation Alliance agreement.  However, CTO Hansen's emphatic petition to declare war on Neuropa was denied.  The Rimtech Board insisted that all diplomatic efforts be explored first.
X_02\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Issadora Toltec provou seu valor desde a primeira missao. Era tao talentosa quanto Diego havia imaginado, tornando-se indispensavel.

X_02\\gobjects.tbd.original:
BACKGROUND
* Neural implants are used to upgrade the skills of Combot crews, vehicle crews, and facility engineers.  
* Combot crew implants increase the crews overall Hand-to-Hand and Ranged attack damage.
* Vehicle upgrades increase vehicles' attack damage.
* Structure upgrades increase structures' build time and defense, while decreasing their manpower requirements.
* While en-route to an engagement, commanders can prebuild units on a SatMap.  When their Matter Converter lands, these units are instantly tightbeamed to their designated positions.
* Some structures emit a defense field, which provides shields to other structures.  Defense Relays will extend the coverage of defense fields if their defense rings intersect.
* Drill trucks are used for underground excavation.

TECHNOLOGICAL ADVANCES
* Energy Shield Arm
* Drilltruck
* Elevator
* Data Relay
X_02\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
CONTEXTO
* Implantes Neurais melhoram habilidades de tripulacoes de Combots e veiculos.

X_02\\gobjects.tbd.original:
Personal log: Angelus, Diego, Serial # RT1654-CTL7
Entry: 2295-096

Well, looks like we pulled another milk-run mission.  No real challenge here.  My staff's spirits remain low.

On the upside, Hansen really came through for me with my replacement second.  Issadora Toltec's the hottest combot pilot to come out of Rimtech since...well, since me!  She's moved up through the ranks nearly as fast as I have.  I haven't seen her since the Three Weeks War, but if she's half as good as she was then, she'll more than make up for Jonus's absence.  I don't know what Hansen's motivation was for assigning her to me, but I intend to make the most of it.
 
Entry: 2295-097

Only minutes until we deploy for our mission. I find myself almost hoping for combat.  Nothing like fighting side by side to pull soldiers together!

X_03\\gobjects.tbd.original:
The fragile coalition of the CorpoNations was nurtured through years of considerable effort by Rimtech.  In spite of repeated attempts to negotiate a settlement, the Alliance was disintegrating.  Neuropa's possession of superior Hedoth technology was an advantage that CTO Hansen decided to neutralize.

X_04\\gobjects.tbd.original:
In a war fought over possession of Hedoth technology, Hedoth ruins and artifacts were constantly sought.  As we know, Hedoth II was an artificial planet containing many Hedoth structures, and Gamma Sector was particularly rich with these Enhancers.  All three CorpoNations vied for this sector, but total domination was elusive.

Rimtech put many survey teams into Gamma Sector, one of which discovered a functioning Hedoth structure.  But before it could be studied, Mil-Agro established a new base nearby, and expelled the survey team.  Due to his prior experience, Diego was assigned to secure the Hedoth structure and eliminate the enemy presence.
X_04\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Numa guerra pela posse da tecnologia Hedoth, as ruinas e artefatos tornaram-se os alvos mais disputados e frequentemente destruidos.

* Inspect Hedoth Structure with any unit to transmit required data back to scientists
* Protect the base's Matter Converter and Research Facility
* Diego and Issadora must survive

OBJETIVOS
* Forcas tightbeam ao asteroide acima da base
* Inspecionar Estrutura Hedoth

X_04\\gobjects.tbd.original: At the conclusion his mission, Diego's squad captured numerous Mil-Agros and Neuropans, including Diego's defector brother: Jonus.  The confrontation between the brothers was brief, as Diego was stunned by Jonus' news that Stefan was now with Mil-Agro.  Each blamed the other for this turn of events.  They would not speak again for the duration of the war.
X_04\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Ao concluir sua missao, o esquadrao de Diego capturou numerosos soldados Mil-Agro e Neuropa, incluindo informantes valiosos.

Personal log: Angelus, Diego, Serial # RT1654-CTL7
Entry: 2295-109

A promotion at last!  That last missions seems to have turned my fortunes around.  And it's in no small part due to Issadora.  I expected her to be good, but, damn, she's better than I could have hoped!  The whole staff's really come together.  There's a confidence there that I haven't seen before.

Entry: 2295-110

I've been reviewing the reports of our survey team.  The forces that drove them used some tactics that are really unorthodox for Mil-Agro.  Instead of a typical massed attack, Mil-Agro carried out a two prong strike, drawing defenses out of position and then hitting their flank.  It's almost exactly the same trick I used against MolecTech during the Munich 15040 Uprising last year.  Could Mil-Agro have heard about that?

Entry: 2295-112

Next mission is to Gamma Sector on Hedoth II.  It's a weird place, not even a planet really.  It's a metal shell constructed around a large moon.  Our archeologists think that the Hedoth built it to be a massive refinery, but no one really knows.  Anyway, this promises to be the toughest mission I've seen in a while.  The Gamma Sector's been a bloodbath for all three CorpoNations, and I can't see taking it for Rimtech.  But, I'm determined to recapture our objective, no matter how many reinforcements Mil-Agro throws in our way.

X_05\\gobjects.tbd.original:
Rimtech had suffered a series of humiliating losses at the hands of its enemies.  Diego threw himself into each new mission, driven by a growing sense of self-importance and a need to restore honor to the family name.  Interestingly, his relationship with Issadora Toltec had moved from a professional level to a personal one, and would ultimately prove costly.

When Neuropa inserted a commando team into a Rimtech storage park, a rapid response was required.  CTO Hansen authorized the expense of tightbeaming Diego to the scene.  His mission: eliminate the intruders before they could launch their Matter Converter and escape.
X_05\\gobjects.tbd.translated: A Rimtech havia sofrido uma serie de perdas humilhantes. Diego foi encarregado de reverter essa mare e demonstrar a forca da corporacao.

* Diego must survive

* Diego sobreviva

X_05\\gobjects.tbd.original: Upon his return to Basecomm, Diego received a long-awaited promotion to Senior Tactical Officer.  However, Diego's moment of glory was short-lived, as he learned that Jonus and another prisoner had escaped from a Rimtech prison camp in the aftermath of a Neuropa raid.  The escape was both an embarrassment to Rimtech, and demoralizing to its troops.  Even more appalling were reports that Mil-Agro had led a massacre at the New Providence training facility, slaughtering scores of defenseless combot crews.
X_05\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Ao retornar ao Basecomm, Diego recebeu uma aguardada promocao a Oficial Tatico Senior, reconhecimento por seus resultados excepcionais.

X_05\\gobjects.tbd.original:
BACKGROUND
* Matter Converters are used to land and depart from planets.  The same neural implants used to control combots are used by combot crews to pilot Matter Converters.
* Damaged Combot arms can be changed in the field with new ones to increase the overall health of combot.
* Combot crews can exit and enter combots in the field.
X_05\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
CONTEXTO
* Matter Converters pousam e decolam dos planetas. Proteja o seu.

X_05\\gobjects.tbd.original:
Personal log: Angelus, Diego, Serial # RT1654-CTL7
Entry: 2295-121

Now I understand why our enemies have been so successful of late!  Stefan's with Mil-Agro!  Now, like Neuropa, they have an inside line on Rimtech's tactics, and are using it against us.  I'm going to have to have to throw out the rulebook and try something unorthodox! 

I still can't believe it...Stefan with Mil-Agro! What could have made Stefan join them?  They're even worse than Neuropa!  As insane as Neuropan beliefs are, at least they adhere to their own code of ethics.  All Mil-Agro is about is the Cob family and their wealth. What's happened to our family?  How could they betray me like that?!

Worse, my disgrace is not even my own!  News of Stefan's leaked, and now all of Rimtech knows that two of the Angelus brothers are traitors!  They talk about it when they think I can't hear.  Conversations stop when I walk into a room.  The Angelus name used to be honorable!  Now it is a name sneered and derided!

At least I captured Jonus.  Jonus and his Neuropa buddy are in a high security cell and won't be going anywhere soon.  Heh, the prison warden is a friend of mine.  I told him to put Jonus through hell during his interrogations.  We're at war -- it's about time we stopped treating prisoners like guests and that's especially true of traitors.

My only solace in Issadora.  She's always there for me, on the battlefield and off.  She knows my shame and still she does not shun me.  She is not blood, but, on my father's grave, she is more family to me now than my brothers.

X_06\\gobjects.tbd.original:
The New Providence massacre was a serious blow to Rimtech, but had a unexpected outcome.  Instead of demoralizing Rimtech, it galvanized opposition to Mil-Agro, both in Rimtech and even Neuropa.  Rimtech's forces were imbued with a new sense of purpose, ferocity, and a need for vengeance.  "For New Providence!" became Rimtech's battle cry.

When satellite imaging revealed an Attack Enhancer near Ty's Gulch, a Mil-Agro sector, Rimtech struck decisively.  Determined to gain an advantage, CTO Hansen sent Diego to capture the Enhancer before Mil-Agro could reach it.  Rescue ships would be sent to evacuate his staff upon mission completion.
X_06\\gobjects.tbd.translated: O massacre de Nova Providencia foi um serio golpe para a Rimtech, mas teve um resultado inesperado: uniu o povo contra a Neuropa.

X_06\\gobjects.tbd.original: Although the Enhancer had been captured, during the ensuing evacuation Diego's squad had been viciously attacked by newly arrived Mil-Agro forces.  Issadora's combot was one of those that did not return from Ty's Gulch.  CTO Hansen listed her as a casualty, but Diego clung desperately to the hope that she was alive.
X_06\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Embora o Intensificador tenha sido capturado, durante a evacuacao o esquadrao de Diego sofreu pesadas baixas.

* Jumpjet Legs create combots with the ability to fly over terrain and transition between surface and orbit layers.
* Hand to Hand Upgrade Legs increase the overall damage inflicted for all HTH weapons used in combat.
* Nemesis vehicles are used to temporarily cripple enemy combots in the field.
* AI Facilities decrease the total number of manpower needed to command structures.

Personal log: Angelus, Diego, Serial # RT1654-CTL7
Entry: 2295-137

Another promotion.  At last, I'm not just another combot jockey.  Not so long ago I dreamed of being a Senior Tactical Officer, but now that I've reach STO status, I'm more frustrated than anything.  I've got authority over my division, but I can't make strategic decisions.  Rimtech is losing this war, and it's partly CTO Hansen's fault.  He's been away from the battlefield too long.  He doesn't understand what it's like with all this new technology and enemies with the inside line on Rimtech.  

Entry: 2295-138

My whole staff has been going on about the New Providence massacre.  They're mad as hell and want to blow Mil-Agro to the galactic rim.  I'm all for that, but it's Stefan I want.  War is war, and it's bad enough that he's dishonored me by going to Mil-Agro, but slaughtering unarmed personnel, that's unconscionable!  Our enemies are no better than animals and deserve no mercy.

Entry: 2295-139

Have to deploy in five hours, but can't sleep.  Too much on my mind. I should be thinking about the mission, but all I can think about is Issadora.  We've gotten so close, closer than I've ever been to anyone.  I think she feels the same, but I can't talk to her about it.  I can't risk CTO Hansen finding out.  He'd transfer her out of my command in a nanosecond.  Emotional attachments have no place in war.  Well, maybe when it's all over.

X_06\\MissionInfo.tbd.original:
The New Providence massacre was a serious blow to Rimtech, but had a unexpected outcome.  Instead of demoralizing Rimtech, it galvanized opposition to Mil-Agro, both in Rimtech and even Neuropa.  Rimtech's forces were imbued with a new sense of purpose, ferocity, and a need for vengeance.  "For New Providence!" became Rimtech's battle cry.

When satellite imaging revealed an Attack Enhancer near Ty's Gulch, a Mil-Agro sector, Rimtech struck decisively.  Determined to gain an advantage, CTO Hansen sent Diego to capture the Enhancer before Mil-Agro could reach it.  Rescue ships would be sent to evacuate his staff upon mission completion.
X_06\\MissionInfo.tbd.translated: O massacre de Nova Providencia foi um serio golpe para a Rimtech, mas teve um resultado inesperado: uniu o povo contra a Neuropa.

X_07\\gobjects.tbd.original:
Rimtech's CommDiv received distress signals from missing members of Diego's squad, who had escaped in a damaged shuttle to a sector of Hedoth III controlled by Neuropa.  Diego sought permission to launch a rescue but CTO Hansen refused.  Resources were scarce, and only one operation was planned for that region: to destroy the newly developed Neuropa railguns that threatened an inbound Rimtech convoy.

Diego usurped this mission from another squad by pulling rank on it's commander. Reports indicated the escapees could be found north of the only suitable landing site. He was determined to rescue them, but needed to destroy the railguns as well.
X_07\\gobjects.tbd.translated: A CommDiv da Rimtech recebeu sinais de socorro de membros desaparecidos do esquadrao de Diego. Uma operacao de resgate foi imediatamente autorizada.

X_07\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Embora bem-sucedido em seus objetivos, foi uma vitoria vazia para Diego. Os prisioneiros confirmaram: Issadora estava morta.

Entry: 2295-159

Just heard that we've received distress beacons from some crewmen we lost in our last battle!  Survivors!  Issadora's alive!  I knew it!

Entry: 2295-160

My people are apparently stranded on Hedoth III, but Hansen won't authorize a rescue mission! "Scarce resources," he says.  Damn, Hansen! I won't sit still and leave them to die in enemy controlled territory!

Hansen's got one mission scheduled for Hedoth III.  GFC Patel's scheduled to command it, but I reassigned her and will lead it myself.  I'm an SFO and command assignments are within my authority. If Hansen finds out, well, he can blow a solar flare.

X_08\\gobjects.tbd.original:
Alarmed by Diego's activities and reports of his increasingly erratic behavior, CTO Hansen ordered Diego's squad to provide security for a Rimtech Board meeting at Sperry Ridge.  Hansen planned to use this opportunity to evaluate Diego's mental state.

Diego, driven beyond his breaking point by grief, ignored Hansen's orders.  IntelDiv had reports that indicated Akiri's Assassins were among the Mil-Agro forces in a nearby sector.  Although this sector held no strategic value in the war, Diego was determined to gain vengeance.
X_08\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Alarmado pelas atividades de Diego e relatos de comportamento erratico, o CTO Hansen decidiu investigar pessoalmente a situacao.

X_08\\gobjects.tbd.original:
GOALS
* Vanquish the enemy
* Diego must survive
* Bonus offered for the capture of Hedoth structures.

Although he succeeded in routing the Mil-Agro forces, Diego did not find Akiri's Assassins.  He believed he had lost his chance to avenge Issadora and his world was collapsing.  He had disobeyed direct orders, lied to his superiors, and fully expected he would never be allowed to pilot a combot again.
X_08\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Embora tenha expulsado as forcas Mil-Agro, Diego nao encontrou os Capangas de Akiri. A busca pela assassina de Issadora continuaria.

Date: 2295-07-13

Sir,

My staff is preparing to join the defense force for the Rimtech Board meeting at the Sperry Ridge base. However, our arrival will be greatly delayed.

IntelDiv reports a Mil-Agro incursion at Ice Sanctuary. As you know, we recently captured this Neuropan stronghold and have not finished fortifying our position.  I believe this sector to be of vital significance to Rimtech's goals and have decided to engage the enemy.  Upon completion of this mission, I will rendezvous at ShuttleHub Delta and continue to Sperry Ridge.

I regret that the urgency at Ice Sanctuary prevents my awaiting your response to this decision.  

Diego Angelus, STO, Rimtech 4th Command.

The shuttle hub had power for a single tightbeam transit and Diego was the ranking officer. He would be tightbeamed, alone, into Sperry Ridge.  His mission: to take command of the base and eliminate the enemy.

X_09\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Sem saber da desobediencia de Diego, o conselho da Rimtech ficou impressionado com os resultados e concedeu uma promocao.

X_10\\gobjects.tbd.original: In contrast to its unsuccessful operations on other Hedoth planets, Rimtech had almost completely conquered Hedoth Prime.  Only one sector of that world remained under Mil-Agro control, and Rimtech wanted exclusive control.  In a move perceived by the Board as an act of supreme bravery, but actually motivated by intelligence reports that Akiri's Assassins were in that region, Diego personally assumed command of the Rimtech forces there.  Undisputed mastery of Hedoth Prime was strategically sound, but eliminating Akiri's Assassins was all that mattered to Diego.
X_10\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Em contraste com operacoes mal-sucedidas em outros planetas Hedoth, a Rimtech havia quase completado o mapeamento deste planeta.

X_10\\gobjects.tbd.original:
Personal log: Angelus, Diego, Serial # RT1654-CTL7
Entry: 2295-171

Mil-Agro sues for peace, using my traitorous brother as a mouthpiece.  Who do they think they're fooling with talk about mind-control and the Cobs?  It's all a damned clever trick.  They've even offered to pull Mil-Agro's forces out of Cinzee Mesa, leaving Hedoth Prime entirely under Rimtech control.  They know full well we can drive them out any time, so it's a meaningless gesture meant to disguise their real intentions!

The Board almost agreed to this insane cease-fire, but I convinced them otherwise.  Stefan betrayed Rimtech once, and he's doing it again. That's why I'm going to strike before they can pull out.  It'll send a message to my traitor brother, and to all who would dishonor Rimtech and the Angelus name!

I'll personally lead this mission against Mil-Agro.  Akiri is among the Mil-Agro forces at Cinzee Mesa, I can practically smell his stench.  He's eluded me before, but not this time.  Vengeance will be mine.

X_10\\MissionInfo.tbd.original: In contrast to its unsuccessful operations on other Hedoth planets, Rimtech had almost completely conquered Hedoth Prime.  Only one sector of that world remained under Mil-Agro control, and Rimtech wanted exclusive control.  In a move perceived by the Board as an act of supreme bravery, but actually motivated by intelligence reports that Akiri's Assassins were in that region, Diego personally assumed command of the Rimtech forces there.  Undisputed mastery of Hedoth Prime was strategically sound, but eliminating Akiri's Assassins was all that mattered to Diego.
X_10\\MissionInfo.tbd.translated: Em contraste com operacoes mal-sucedidas em outros planetas Hedoth, a Rimtech havia quase completado o mapeamento deste planeta.

X_10\\MissionInfo.tbd.original:
Personal log: Angelus, Diego, Serial # RT1654-CTL7
Entry: 2295-171

Mil-Agro sues for peace, using my traitorous brother as a mouthpiece.  Who do they think they're fooling with talk about mind-control and the Cobs?  It's all a damned clever trick.  They've even offered to pull Mil-Agro's forces out of Cinzee Mesa, leaving Hedoth Prime entirely under Rimtech control.  They know full well we can drive them out any time, so it's a meaningless gesture meant to disguise their real intentions!

The Board almost agreed to this insane cease-fire, but I convinced them otherwise.  Stefan betrayed Rimtech once, and he's doing it again. That's why I'm going to strike before they can pull out.  It'll send a message to my traitor brother, and to all who would dishonor Rimtech and the Angelus name!

I'll personally lead this mission against Mil-Agro.  Akiri is among the Mil-Agro forces at Cinzee Mesa, I can practically smell his stench.  He's eluded me before, but not this time.  Vengeance will be mine.

Y_01\\gobjects.tbd.original:
The second nexus subject is Stefan Angelus,   the youngest of the three Angelus brothers.   At Rimtech he had been Diego's protege, and was fiercely loyal to the family.  

Stefan's "rescue" by the Mil-Agro Skyhawks was not the blessing he initially thought.  Mil-Agro's reputation as the most brutal CorpoNation was well deserved.  Mil-Agro's business began with penal colonies and forced labor exo-farms, but grew to encompass deep space mining and other hazardous industries.  Criminals, undesirables, and the poor, populated Mil-Agro's ranks.  All were secretly fitted with neural implants, forcing their obedience to Mil-Agro and its founders, the Cob family.

The CorpoNations were not yet in a declared state of war, but this was irrelevant to Mil-Agro.  Stefan was sent to Hedoth III, where rival Neuropa had begun an excavation project.  His mission: to launch a sneak attack and destroy the enemy base.
Y_01\\gobjects.tbd.translated: O segundo sujeito nexus e Stefan Angelus, o cacula dos tres irmaos Angelus. Na Rimtech era o protegido de Diego. Sua captura pela Mil-Agro foi um choque para todos.

Y_01\\gobjects.tbd.original:
From the personal journal of Stefan Angelus.
Entry 1

I'm writing down my thoughts so there might be some record of what happened to me.

My memories are clear up to the point where Jonus argued with Diego about the alien arm.  After that, it's all disjointed images: falling, crushing pain, shadowy figures lifting me from darkness, and fitful dreams that seemed to go on forever.  Then I awoke here, at Mil-Agro.  My first impulse was to ask them for a commlink to Rimtech, but when I tried to open my mouth, I couldn't speak.  But when they asked me a question, I found myself speaking.  I could not control the urge to tell them anything they wanted, even Rimtech military information!  That's when I realized they'd done something to me. I tried to lash out, but my body wouldn't obey.

At Rimtech we'd always wondered about the stoicism of Mil-Agro forces.  Now I understand.  Mil-Agro conditions its forces somehow.  They...we -- I'm one of them now -- are inhibited in some way.  Brainwashing?  I can't be certain.  My mind is intact, but I've been robbed of the ability to fight back, to disobey, even to tell them how much I hate them for what they've done to me.  When I'm alone I can scream and curse and damn them all, but when I try to take any actual action against them, it's as if my body isn't mine, and I'm scared to death what they might make me do.

Y_02\\gobjects.tbd.original:
The Cob family sought to press its advantage before all-out war commenced and several Rimtech bases were selected for immediate attack.  The Mil-Agro forces were instructed to crush the enemy.

Brik Cob was determined to test Stefan.  Stefan was sent on a particularly difficult mission to Cor'nanda Canyon on Hedoth Prime, and he was assigned a roster of raw "recruits".  One of these recruits, a youth named Akiri Sasahara, would eventually become a central figure in the lives of Brik Cob, Stefan, and Diego.
Y_02\\gobjects.tbd.translated: A familia Cob buscou pressionar sua vantagem antes da guerra total, tentando apoderar-se de territorios Rimtech ricos em artefatos Hedoth.

Y_02\\gobjects.tbd.translated:

* Stefan e Akiri sobrevivam

Y_02\\gobjects.tbd.original: Although successful, the mission had been punishing.  Stefan was surprised by the efforts of his staff, and particularly Akiri, whose loyalty and effort far exceeded what he had expected from forced conscripts.
Y_02\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Embora bem-sucedida, a missao foi extenuante. Stefan ficou surpreso com a brutalidade com que a Mil-Agro tratava seus proprios aliados.

Y_02\\gobjects.tbd.original:
BACKGROUND
* Cobs name areas after family heroes.
* Neural implants are used to upgrade the skills of Combot crews, vehicle crews, and facility engineers.  
* Combot crew implants increase the crews overall Hand-to-Hand and Ranged attack damage.
* Vehicle upgrades increase vehicles' attack damage.
* Structure upgrades increase structures' build time and defense, while decreasing their manpower requirements.
* While en-route to an engagement, commanders can prebuild units on a SatMap.  When their Matter Converter lands, these units are instantly tightbeamed to their designated positions.
* Some structures emit an integrity field, which provide shields to other structures.  This creates defense rings.  Defense Relays will extend the coverage of defense rings if their defense rings intersect.
* Drill trucks are used for underground excavation.
* Recon Poles will reveal terrain simultaneously on the surface and underground.

TECHNOLOGICAL ADVANCES
* PowerGun Legs
* Drill Truck
* Elevator
* Data Relay
* Recon Pole
Y_02\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
CONTEXTO
* Os Cob nomeiam areas apos herois da familia.
* Implantes Neurais melhoram tripulacoes.

Y_02\\gobjects.tbd.original:
From the personal journal of Stefan Angelus.
Entry 8

I've been been sent to a frontline base at Cor'nanda Canyon under the command of Senior Taskmaster Brik Cob.  He's something like a Rimtech STO, devising mission plans and assigning crews, and seems to have taken an instant dislike to me.  He brags about loading our neural implant control codes into his personal Overseer module so he can tinker with our minds.  He says there are more where we came from, so if we screw up, he'll just order us to kill ourselves and make way for others. Some days I wish he would.

Entry 13

Had a green "recruit" assigned to me today; kid named Akiri.  His family's in a Mil-Agro penal colony and he's here right out of combot training.  He does his best to put up a brave front, but everyone can see he's scared.  The names or our crews are selected by the Taskmasters -- Brik Cob thought it would be funny to code name Akiri's crew "Assasins". Brik's the only one laughing.

Entry 15

Totally screwed up in the combot simulator, and Brik won't let me forget it.  I always resented Diego and Jonus treating me like a total cadet, but maybe they were right.  Maybe I don't have what it takes.  I never realized how much I counted on their support before.  Without them there, I don't know how I'll make it.

Entry 17

The kid and I are being sent to attack some Rimtech bases.  Rimtech!  My god, I'm expected to fight my own people...even kill them.  I'm powerless to disobey, resist or even to allow myself to come to harm.  Mil-Agro pilots me like I pilot a combot.
Y_02\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
Diario pessoal de Stefan Angelus.
Registro 8

Fui enviado a mais uma missao impossivel. A Mil-Agro nao se importa com baixas — somos recursos a consumir. Pelo menos Akiri e competente. Juntos temos chances reais de sobreviver.

Y_03\\gobjects.tbd.original:
To date Mil-Agro had been fortunate that its blatant acts of aggression had not resulted in open declarations of war.  Rimtech continued to sue for peace, and Neuropa appeared outwardly indecisive.  The Cobs feigned interest in a negotiated settlement while secretly pressing forward with their attacks.

The Cob family patriarch, Zeke Cob, personally briefed Stefan on his next mission.  Neuropa had gained advanced Hedoth technology, and Cob was determined to keep them from getting more.  Stefan was to destroy two Neuropan archeology stations.  He was not to waste time on orbiting forces, but to concentrate on eliminating the target installations.  Intrigued by Stefan's previous performance, Zeke offered extra upgrades if the enemy could be defeated in less than 100 minutes.
Y_03\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Ate entao a Mil-Agro havia tido a sorte de que seus atos de agressao nao haviam desencadeado uma resposta coordenada de todos seus inimigos.

Y_03\\gobjects.tbd.original:
GOALS
* Vanquish Neuropa's surface and underground Archeology stations.
* Bonus if mission completed in less than 100 minutes
* Stefan and Akiri must survive
Y_03\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
OBJETIVOS
* Vencer estacoes Arq. Neuropa.
* Bonus se concluido rapidamente.

Y_03\\gobjects.tbd.original: The success of Stefan and Akiri challenged the strategic theories of Brik Cob, who expected few if any of the new recruits to survive the mission.  Afterwards, Brik would give Stefan the toughest assignments, curious to see which one would break him.
Y_03\\gobjects.tbd.translated: O sucesso de Stefan e Akiri desafiou as teorias de Brik Cob, que havia subestimado gravemente a capacidade da dupla.

Y_03\\gobjects.tbd.original:
BACKGROUND
* Outposts are tightbeam teleportation sites which are particularly useful for travel between the orbit and surface.  However, the unique mineral composition of the Hedoth crust is beyond the ken of humans, so they are unable to teleport underground.
* Captured combat parts that are deposited at the Assemby Bay can be researched in the Research Facility. Once finished they can be produced in your Factories.

TECHNOLOGICAL ADVANCES
* Gattling Gun Arm
* Powershield Legs
* Recon Torso
* Mobile Artillery
* Mobile Wall Gun Turret
* Mobile Wall Laser Turret
* Solar Panel
* Outpost
* Research Facility
Y_03\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
CONTEXTO
* Postos Avancados sao teleportadores tightbeam uteis para combots.

Y_03\\gobjects.tbd.original:
From the personal journal of Stefan Angelus.
Entry 18

God, I feel sick.  In my last mission I was fighting and killing my former comrades.  From inside a combot it's so hard to know whom you're fighting, and, for all I know, I may have killed old friends as I served the greater glory of Mil-Agro.  What next?  Will I someday fight and kill my own brothers? 
  
Entry 20

For my latest mission briefing, I was paraded before old Zeke Cob himself. I wouldn't have thought anyone could be colder than Brik, but Zeke is.  He's hawkish, almost cadaverous, except for his eyes, which cut right through you.  He treated me like I was a dog he was siccing on someone.  At first I didn't understand why he was briefing me personally, but, when he asked me about Jonus, then I understood.  I'd forgotten Jonus had planned to go over to Neuropa with that alien arm.  I guess they wanted to see if I knew anything about it.
Y_03\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
Diario pessoal de Stefan Angelus.
Registro 18

Deus, me sinto mal. Na ultima missao ataquei soldados Rimtech. Sei que nao tive escolha, os implantes me controlam, mas a culpa e insuportavel. Diego e Jonus precisam saber o que me fizeram.

Inevitably, both Rimtech and Neuropa declared war upon one another and upon Mil-Agro.  Even Mil-Agro's considerable advantage in unit numbers threatened to be insufficient with all three CorpoNations in open conflict.  The Cobs gambled that Rimtech and Neuropa distrusted each other too much to join forces against them.  As long as the war was three-way, Mil-Agro might prevail.

Gamma Sector of Hedoth II, rich in Hedoth artifacts, remained one of the primary battlegrounds of the war.  When Mil-Agro reconnaissance located a previously undiscovered Hedoth structure, Stefan was dispatched to investigate and secure control of it.
Y_04\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Inevitavelmente, Rimtech e Neuropa declararam guerra uma a outra e a Mil-Agro. A era da guerra total havia comecado.

Y_05\\gobjects.tbd.original:
When Mil-Agro's forces in Cor'nanda Canyon were routed by Rimtech, a combot crew led by Brik Cob was lost in the area.  
Victory was impossible, and Mil-Agro's only option was evacuation.  However, the Cob family would not allow evacuation to commence until Brik was found.

Stefan was familiar with the area from a prior mission so he was tightbeamed in.  His mission was to locate Brik's crew and get them back to the landing zone as quickly as possible. Once there Brik was to enter the Matter Converter and blast off the planet.
Y_05\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Quando as forcas da Mil-Agro no Canion Cor'nanda foram derrotadas pela Rimtech, uma tripulacao liderada por Brik Cob ficou presa atras das linhas inimigas.

Y_05\\gobjects.tbd.original:
GOALS
* Return Brik Cob crew to main base.
* Brik Cob must pilot Matter Converter blast-off.
* Stefan and Brik Cob must survive.
Y_05\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
OBJETIVOS
* Retornar equipe Brik Cob a base.
* Brik Cob deve pilotar o MConverter

Y_05\\gobjects.tbd.original: The losses in Cor'nanda Canyon had staggered Mil-Agro.  Stefan's success in rescuing Brik Cob was a notable highlight.  Brik returned a humbled man, realizing that it was Stefan's individual skill and experience that had saved him when all of Mil-Agro's massed might had failed.
Y_05\\gobjects.tbd.translated: As perdas no Canion Cor'nanda abalaram a Mil-Agro. O sucesso de Stefan em resgatar Brik Cob foi um raro ponto positivo numa campanha sombria.

Y_05\\gobjects.tbd.original:
BACKGROUND
* Matter Converters are used to land and depart from planets.  The same neural implants used to control combots are used by combot crews to pilot Matter Converters.
* Combot arms can be changed in the field
Y_05\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
CONTEXTO
* Matter Converters pousam e decolam dos planetas. Proteja o seu.

Y_05\\gobjects.tbd.original:
From the personal journal of Stefan Angelus.
Entry 36

They think nothing of throwing away our lives, but it's different when it's one of their own.  I'm being sent back to Cor'nanda Canyon on a suicide mission to rescue Brik Cob. 

Brik's a big believer in Mil-Agro's strategy that overwhelming numbers, not skillful pilots, insure success.  And he's made my life miserable for my supposed reputation as an "ace" combot leader.  So it's a cruel irony that I'm the one who's being sent, by myself, to save him.  I can't wait to see his reaction.  If I live that long.
Y_05\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
Diario pessoal de Stefan Angelus.
Registro 36

Nao lhes importa nada alem dos objetivos militares. Sou uma ferramenta. Quando estou sozinho penso com clareza, mas na presenca deles meu corpo simplesmente obedece.

While Akiri was sent to defend Ty's Gulch, Stefan was tightbeamed to a Rimtech combot crew training area at New Providence.
Y_06\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Contrariando as objecoes de Brik Cob e dos assessores seniors, o patriarca Zeki Cob enviou patrulhas para investigar relatos de atividade Rimtech.

Y_06\\gobjects.tbd.original:
GOALS
* Destroy the Crew Training Facility before the extraction team arrives (15 minutes)
* Stefan must survive.
Y_06\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
OBJETIVOS
* Destruir Instalacao Treinamento antes da extracao (15 min)

Y_06\\gobjects.tbd.original: Unable to resist the controlling force of the implants, Stefan succeeded in his mission, slaughtering scores of his former Rimtech comrades.  The New Providence massacre would prove to be the beginning of the Cob family's downfall, galvanizing their enemies and seeding dissension within the family itself.
Y_06\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Incapaz de resistir aos implantes, Stefan teve sucesso em sua missao, sabendo que carregaria o peso de suas acoes pelo resto da vida.

Y_06\\gobjects.tbd.original:
BACKGROUND
* Jetpack Torsos create combots with the ability to fly over terrain and transition between surface and orbit layers.
* Steady Legs increase the chances of amputating enemy parts in combat.

* Steady Legs
* CarpetBomb Arm
* Nemesis
* Hover Bomber
* AI Facility

Y_06\\gobjects.tbd.original:
From the personal journal of Stefan Angelus.
Entry 40

I'm sickened by my new orders.  I'm being sent to annihilate a Rimtech training camp.  This isn't war, it's cold-blooded murder!  It wasn't so long ago I was training in camp like this one.  These aren't even soldiers we're going to be killing, they're trainees!

It's almost a relief to me that Akiri isn't with me. He's being sent to defend Ty's Gulch from Rimtech incursions, so at least he'll be spared the horror of what I'm being sent to do.

Entry 41

Got the biggest surprise of my life today.  On my way to deploy for this bloodbath, Brik Cob told me he was sorry that I had to go on this mission!  He said he'd argued with the family, but they wouldn't listen to him.  Could this be true?  And, why did he apologize to me?  Perhaps he looks on me a little differently after I rescued him.
Y_06\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
Diario pessoal de Stefan Angelus.
Registro 40

Estou enjoado com minhas novas ordens. Akiri e eficiente e brutal. Trabalhamos bem em campo mas mal nos falamos fora das missoes. Ela nao confia em mim.

Stefan was ordered to capture the Hedoth structures and to eliminate the Rimtech presence.  Akiri was reassigned to Stefan's command, unaware that he had become the target of Diego Angelus' wrath.
Y_07\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Um banco de dados Rimtech capturado forneceu a Mil-Agro a localizacao de um massivo complexo de pesquisa rival repleto de dados sensiveis.

* Stefan must survive

However,  Zekiel Cob would hear no dissension and tolerate no defiance.
Y_07\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Com seus inimigos redobrando esforcos apos o massacre de Nova Providencia, Stefan foi convocado para liderar uma contraofensiva decisiva.

* Railguns fire projectiles over great distances.

* Point Defense System deflect railgun attacks with their protectors.

* Railgun Phase Charge Turret
* Railgun Recon Pole Salvo
Y_07\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
CONTEXTO
* Veiculos Nemesis paralisam combots inimigos temporariamente em campo.

Y_07\\gobjects.tbd.original:
From the personal journal of Stefan Angelus.
Entry 42

The last mission was the worst of all.  I killed scores of defenseless people, and there was nothing I could do to stop myself.  The only thing that keeps me going is my staff.  Despite my efforts to keep this from them, they learned all about it, and they've been there supporting me the way I've always tried to support them.  There's a sense of -- hell, can I call it family?  

Entry 43

Brik actually listened to me and reassigned Akiri to my staff.  Akiri's upset about what happened on his mission at Ty's Gulch.  He knows that he was up against Diego's squad and he's afraid he might have killed my brother.  I told him he's getting cocky thinking he could take out a veteran like Diego.  That seems to have helped a little, but I can tell he's bothered.

Entry 43

My next mission must be an important one since I'm finally being allowed to upgrade my staff.  Is this Brik's doing too?

Registro 42

A ultima missao foi a pior ate agora. Nao pelo combate, mas pelo que fui forcado a fazer depois. Nao consigo escrever os detalhes. Precisarei encontrar uma forma de viver com minhas acoes.

Brik Cob and his staff had rebelled against Zekiel Cob, revealing the identities of all Mil-Agro agents to their enemies.  Brik was arrested for treason and condemned to death.
Y_08\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Ao concluir a missao no Santuario de Gelo, Stefan ouviu Supervisores seniors planejando elimina-lo assim que deixasse de ser util.

Y_08\\gobjects.tbd.original:
From the personal journal of Stefan Angelus.
Entry 56

They don't tell us much, although I've heard Jonus is with Neuropa.  I was surprised when I first heard he had gone over, but now that I've had time to think about it, it's just like Jonus to think about himself.  I used to blindly idolize Jonus and Diego, but now I look back and see them differently.  They're human like the rest of us and have flaws like the rest of us too.  Guess I'm just getting older.

I used to dream of a day when I might take my staff with me, leave Mil-Agro and go back to Rimtech.  I still do, but sometimes I wonder if Rimtech is worth returning to. I've heard some horror stories about Rimtech.  If they're true, Rimtech's becoming as brutal as the Cobs.  This war is changing everything. If only I could talk to Diego.

Diario pessoal de Stefan Angelus.
Registro 56

Nao nos dizem muito sobre a guerra, embora eu saiba que estamos perdendo terreno em varios frontes. Brik Cob parece cada vez mais desesperado, o que significa missoes mais perigosas.

Y_09\\gobjects.tbd.original:
From the personal journal of Stefan Angelus.
Entry 61

I feel reborn.  My mind and body are my own again!  Brik's Overseer shut off our implants. I think it's a final gift from Brik for saving his life.  Now's our chance to escape!

Entry 62

I told my staff I'd lead them back to a Rimtech controlled territory. But, Akiri told me he wouldn't go.  He says it's not right to leave as long others are still imprisoned by Mil-Agro's mind control. He's going to stay and fight for their release too.

I was stunned.  Escape was what we had dreamed about, what had kept us going through this living hell.  But he's right.  The people here are puppets, like us, and have fought alongside us.  We owe them a chance at freedom too.

It's crazy, but saving Brik Cob, once again, seems like the only chance to save my fellow conscripts from the tyranny of the Cobs.  I'm not certain what saving Brik might accomplish, he knew how to deactivate our implants, so maybe there is some hope he can deactivate other ones as well? Perhaps everyone can have a chance to escape!  Perhaps not, but I have to try.

Entry 63

We're just moments away from combat.  I'm surprised at how simple it's been to get this far.  Even obtaining a tightbeam to the prison area was easy.  No one is capable of acting without orders blessed by the Cobs, so no one questioned it when my squad asked to be tightbeamed to the Field H.Q. sector!

Y_10\\gobjects.tbd.original:
With their conditioning broken, the subjects of Mil-Agro were now free, but had nowhere to go.  The war had transformed pacifistic Rimtech into a CorpoNation as brutal as Mil-Agro, and supplication to the Neuropa regime appealed to no one.  

Stefan's first act was to promise the one-time slaves of Mil-Agro a chance at a new life if they would all stand together.  He offered a truce to both Rimtech and Neuropa, but both flatly refused it. The other corponations perceived an opportunity to finally eliminate the weakened Mil-Agro, so the state of war would continue.

Stefan realized that the only path to peace was through a demonstration of strength.  Rimtech and Neuropa would have to be shown that Mil-Agro assets were not theirs for the taking.  Mil-Agro's presence was strongest on Hedoth II.  If Stefan could lead his ragtag group to victory there, it would provide the requisite demonstration.

If not, Mil-Agro would truly be dead.
Y_10\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Com seu condicionamento quebrado, os sujeitos da Mil-Agro estavam livres, mas tinham de enfrentar as memorias dolorosas de tudo que foram forcados a fazer.

Y_10\\gobjects.tbd.original:

My responsibility is to my brothers and sisters in arms at Mil-Agro.  Like me, they were ripped away from their families and homes.  Like me, the lives they left are no longer there to be resumed.  The life I had with Rimtech and my brothers is gone.  What's important now is my responsibility here. We'll build new lives, and new dreams, on the ashes of the old Mil-Agro.

Z_01\\gobjects.tbd.original:
The third nexus subject is Jonus Angelus.  The middle of the three Angelus brothers, his ambition rivaled Diego's, but his primary loyalty was to himself.  By taking the Hedoth arm to Neuropa, Jonus had helped trigger the CorpoNation war.
 
Neuropa differed from the other CorpoNations by engaging in profit to advance a belief system.  Worshiping alien technology was the core tenet of Neuropa.

Jonus' arrival in possession of a new type of Hedoth arm provided a propaganda coup that brought many new converts to the Neuropan faith. Moreover, tactically the arm gave them a technological advantage with which to overcome nonbelievers.

While the Neuropa Theocracy considered what to do with Jonus, he was assigned to combot duty.  His first mission: investigate a nearby Hedoth structure.  He was to avoid combat with the other CorpoNations, as Neuropa wished to avoid the appearance of being at war.
Z_01\\gobjects.tbd.translated: O terceiro sujeito nexus e Jonus Angelus. O irmao do meio dos tres Angelus, sua ambicao e espiritualidade o tornaram vulneravel a manipulacao da Neuropa.

Z_01\\gobjects.tbd.original: Jonus's engaging enemy forces in combat infuriated the Neuropa Theocracy, which was obsessed with secrecy and clandestine action.  As penance, Jonus was instructed to study the Hedoth and meditate on obedience while the Theocracy considered how best to enlighten him.
Z_01\\gobjects.tbd.translated: O envolvimento de Jonus em combate enfureceu a Teocracia Neuropa, que o queria como simbolo espiritual, longe do campo de batalha.

Recorded this 358th day of the 64th year of our Enlightenment

Well, here I am, at Neuropa and it feels pretty damn good!  They've treated me like a hero.  Their tech skills and their fanaticism are even stronger than I'd heard. They celebrate that damned arm like it was the second coming of their Great Prophet Jerodyn!

I figured bringing them that alien arm would land me in senior management.  Well, they made me a senior combot commander, so now I'm higher ranked than Diego! Well, it's Diego's loss that he didn't come with me.  Diego's blindly loyal to Rimtech, just like father was.  If he's not careful, he'll end up another casualty of Rimtech's short-sightedness too.

Z_02\\gobjects.tbd.original: Following his success, Jonus was surprised that, instead of being praised, he was assigned to be a disciple to Komrov.  A celebrated Neuropa philosopher and warrior, Komrov had fought with distinction in earlier conflicts and even escaped internment from a Mil-Agro prison camp during the Munich 15040 Uprising.  While Komrov was not to interfere with Jonus's command, his task was to ensure Jonus actions conformed to the Neuropan faith.
Z_02\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Apos seu sucesso, Jonus ficou surpreso ao ser designado para missao ainda mais perigosa em vez de ser elogiado.

Z_02\\gobjects.tbd.original:
BACKGROUND
* Neural implants are used to upgrade the skills of Combot crews, vehicle crews, and facility engineers.  
* Combot crew implants increase the crews overall Hand-to-Hand and Ranged attack damage.
* Vehicle upgrades increase vehicles' attack damage.
* Structure upgrades increase structures' build time and defense, while decreasing their manpower requirements.
* While en-route to an engagement, commanders can prebuild units on a SatMap.  When their Matter Converter lands, these units are instantly tightbeamed to their designated positions.
* Some structures emit an integrity field, which provide shields to other structures.  This creates defense rings.  Defense Relays will extend the coverage of defense rings if their defense rings intersect.
* Drill trucks are used for underground excavation.
* Drilltrucks can capture Hedoth structures

TECHNOLOGICAL ADVANCES
* Electro Grip Arm
* Drill Truck
* Elevator
* Defense Relay
* Imaging Pole
Z_02\\gobjects.tbd.translated:

* Implantes Neurais melhoram habilidades de tripulacoes de Combots e veiculos.

Z_02\\gobjects.tbd.original:
Personal testament of Brother Jonus Angelus, of The Divine Order of Neuropa
Recorded this 363rd day of the 64th year of our Enlightenment

The Theocracy seemed miffed about my last mission.  It's a minor misunderstanding.  Meanwhile, I've settled in at Neuropa.  My staff are great.  They're smart, loyal and capable as any at Rimtech, but there's no real sense of "belonging" yet.  They're all true believers, and I'm not.  

Everyone knows Neuropa's religion is based on the aliens, but I had no idea how far that went.  Neuropa revolves around the aliens and religious devotion to their memory and their artifacts. It's insane.  Everything around here has some religious significance.  I mean, look at this...even my personal log isn't just a log.  I was told it was my place to record my personal confessions, and thus cleanse my mind for Hedoth enlightenment!  

Oh well, lack of camaraderie is a small price to pay for how far I've advanced my career.  Hah, I'd better be careful, or I might convince myself I miss Rimtech!

My next mission is to Hedoth II.  Pretty basic stuff.  Teach Mil-Agro a lesson.  The Theocracy wants me to leave the enemy orbital forces alone, and, despite their holy-speak rationalization, it makes good tactical sense to leave survivors who can tell Mil-Agro we're no pushovers.

Z_02\\MissionInfo.tbd.original: Following his success, Jonus was surprised that, instead of being praised, he was assigned to be a disciple to Komrov.  A celebrated Neuropa philosopher and warrior, Komrov had fought with distinction in earlier conflicts and even escaped internment from a Mil-Agro prison camp during the Munich 15040 Uprising.  While Komrov was not to interfere with Jonus's command, his task was to ensure Jonus actions conformed to the Neuropan faith.
Z_02\\MissionInfo.tbd.translated: Apos seu sucesso, Jonus ficou surpreso ao ser designado para missao ainda mais perigosa em vez de ser elogiado.

Z_02\\MissionInfo.tbd.original:
BACKGROUND
* Neural implants are used to upgrade the skills of Combot crews, vehicle crews, and facility engineers.  
* Combot crew implants increase the crews overall Hand-to-Hand and Ranged attack damage.
* Vehicle upgrades increase vehicles' attack damage.
* Structure upgrades increase structures' build time and defense, while decreasing their manpower requirements.
* While en-route to an engagement, commanders can prebuild units on a SatMap.  When their Matter Converter lands, these units are instantly tightbeamed to their designated positions.
* Some structures emit an integrity field, which provide shields to other structures.  This creates defense rings.  Defense Relays will extend the coverage of defense rings if their defense rings intersect.
* Drill trucks are used for underground excavation.
* Drilltrucks can capture Hedoth structures

TECHNOLOGICAL ADVANCES
* Electro Grip Arm
* Drill Truck
* Elevator
* Defense Relay
* Imaging Pole
Z_02\\MissionInfo.tbd.translated:
CONTEXTO
* Implantes Neurais melhoram habilidades de tripulacoes de Combots e veiculos.

Z_02\\MissionInfo.tbd.original:
Personal testament of Brother Jonus Angelus, of The Divine Order of Neuropa
Recorded this 363rd day of the 64th year of our Enlightenment

The Theocracy seemed miffed about my last mission.  It's a minor misunderstanding.  Meanwhile, I've settled in at Neuropa.  My staff are great.  They're smart, loyal and capable as any at Rimtech, but there's no real sense of "belonging" yet.  They're all true believers, and I'm not.  

Everyone knows Neuropa's religion is based on the aliens, but I had no idea how far that went.  Neuropa revolves around the aliens and religious devotion to their memory and their artifacts. It's insane.  Everything around here has some religious significance.  I mean, look at this...even my personal log isn't just a log.  I was told it was my place to record my personal confessions, and thus cleanse my mind for Hedoth enlightenment!  

Oh well, lack of camaraderie is a small price to pay for how far I've advanced my career.  Hah, I'd better be careful, or I might convince myself I miss Rimtech!

My next mission is to Hedoth II.  Pretty basic stuff.  Teach Mil-Agro a lesson.  The Theocracy wants me to leave the enemy orbital forces alone, and, despite their holy-speak rationalization, it makes good tactical sense to leave survivors who can tell Mil-Agro we're no pushovers.
Z_02\\MissionInfo.tbd.translated:
Testamento de Irmao Jonus Angelus, da Sagrada Ordem da Neuropa
Registrado neste dia da Iluminacao

Cada dia aqui e uma revelacao. A Neuropa possui conhecimentos que a Rimtech jamais sonhou. Komrov tem sido um guia paciente. Mas ha algo perturbador que ainda nao consigo definir.

Z_02\\MissionInfo.tbd.original: Enemy has been defeated! - MISSION COMPLETE

If possible, he was to demolish the associated Research and A.I. facility as well.  Much to Jonus's displeasure, Magister Komrov would be accompanying him as his second in command.

Upon completion of the mission objectives, Jonus and Komrov were to  launch a Matter Converter.

Z_03\\gobjects.tbd.original: To Jonus' surprise, Komrov had proved an asset in the mission.  Although his reflexes weren't those of a young man, his keen tactical insight more than compensated.  Furthermore, Komrov's post-mission report to the Theocracy was highly favorable. As a result, Jonus and his crew received commendations and commensurate upgrade approvals.
Z_03\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Para surpresa de Jonus, Komrov havia se mostrado um aliado valioso. Sua experiencia e astucisa eram inestimáveis.

Recorded this 20th day of the 65th year of our Enlightenment

Okay, so I'm not following their so-called "enlightened path".  I think they'd be happier if I failed if I would just swear my infinite devotion to the Hedoth.  But, because I won't, they've assigned some religious master to guide me.  Well, I'll play along, but I'm not going to let him push me around.  I didn't take it from Diego, and I sure as hell won't take it from this Komrov!

Z_04\\gobjects.tbd.original:
In The Neuropan Testament of the Illumination, the Prophet Jerodyn foretold of the time when the righteous would cleanse the holy worlds of heretics.  The jihad would result in the ascension of the faithful, and the fall of the unbelievers, and signal the return of the Hedoth.
 
The first action of this jihad was in hotly contested Gamma Sector of Hedoth II, in which Rimtech and Mil-Agro forces were already actively engaged.  Jonus and Komrov were to capture a Hedoth structure there, then send the research materials back to Neuropa by having a junior crew blast off with it.  Jonus and Komrov, would maintain a rear-guard action.

They did not speak again for the duration of the war.
Z_04\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Embora bem-sucedido no objetivo principal, apos a decolagem do Matter Converter, Diego descobriu o preco de sua desobediencia.

Z_05\\gobjects.tbd.original:
Following their capture, Jonus and Komrov were placed in high security confinement in a Rimtech prison.  Days of brutal interrogation followed, but Jonus stoically resisted.  The warden of the Rimtech prison believed it was due to Neuropa conditioning, but depression and shame were the true roots of Jonus' silence. 

Three days after their capture, a Mil-Agro surprise attack damaged the prison and defense grid.  In the chaos, Komrov and Jonus escaped and signaled Neuropa for assistance. A tactical team was inserted in the southeast portion of the sector to provide support, but Jonus and Komrov would first have to elude the Rimtech forces to take command of the support team.
Z_05\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Apos sua captura, Jonus e Komrov foram colocados em confinamento de alta seguranca. Suas chances de escape pareciam nulas.

Z_05\\gobjects.tbd.original:
GOALS
* Escape to southwest sector.
* Vanquish the enemy forces.
* Jonus and Komrov must survive.
Z_05\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
OBJETIVOS
* Escapar para sudoeste.
* Vencer forcas inim.
* Jonus e Komrov sobrevivam

Z_05\\gobjects.tbd.original:
The escape had given Jonus an increased respect for Komrov.  For the first time since he had come to Neuropa, Jonus felt a real bond to one of his comrades.

Jonus had been humbled by the experience of being captured by his brother.  Still, Neuropa trumpeted how their brave disciples survived Rimtech persecution.  Jonus was proclaimed a Neuropan hero, who would even fight his own family for the Neuropan way.  It was masterful propaganda, but both Jonus and his masters knew it was a hollow lie.
Z_05\\gobjects.tbd.translated: A fuga havia dado a Jonus um respeito muito maior por Komrov. Pela primeira vez via o Magistrado como verdadeiro aliado.

Z_06\\gobjects.tbd.original:
A Neuropa survey team had discovered numerous Hedoth structures, surrounded by inert guard drones.  However, the moment the Neuropans entered one structure, the drones activated and destroyed the survey team .  Shortly thereafter, Mil-Agro forces entered the sector.  Mil-Agro's swift response implied they had prior knowledge of Neuropa's plans.
 
Counter-attack was imperative.  Jonus was to capture the Hedoth structures before Mil-Agro could.  Only once this task was completed would he and his staff be permitted to blast off.
Z_06\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Uma equipe Neuropa havia descoberto numerosas estruturas Hedoth cercadas por guardas inertes e incontaveis artefatos aliens.

* Decolar com o MConverter.

Z_06\\gobjects.tbd.original: In spite of himself, Jonus grew fond of Komrov.  The Magister would regale him with tales from his youth, but he would avoid questions about his experiences after joining Neuropa.  He insisted the topic was too dangerous to discuss.  Mysteriously, he cautioned Jonus to not publicly defy the Theocracy, or they would arrange for him to serve them in death as a martyr.
Z_06\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Apesar de si mesmo, Jonus foi se encantando com Komrov. O Magistrado o entretinha com historias fascinantes da filosofia Neuropa.

Z_06\\gobjects.tbd.original:
Personal testament of Brother Jonus Angelus, of The Divine Order of Neuropa
Recorded this 56th day of the 65th year of our Enlightenment

My capture exposed me to a side of Rimtech I'd never seen before.  The interrogations were brutal...what I'd expect from Mil-Agro, not Rimtech.  If this is an indication of what Rimtech is becoming, I'm glad I left when I did!  I can't believe I'm actually relieved to be back.

To hear Neuropa tell it, I'll even fight my family to defend Neuropa and its beliefs.  Everyone around here keeps treating me like a hero.  Gullible fools.  It was Komrov who got us out of that prison and saved my life. First he escapes from the Mil-Agro prison during the Munich Uprising and now he escapes a Rimtech prison!  He's the real hero, and he's getting none of the credit.  I asked him if the lack of recognition bothers him, and he said he doesn't want any attention.  He's such a gentle man, I don't understand why he's with Neuropa at all, let alone having been with them long enough to become a Magister.

Recorded this 57th day of the 65th year of our Enlightenment

I can't sleep nights.  I keep thinking back to that screaming match I had with Diego in the prison.  Diego actually blamed me for Stefan going to over to Mil-Agro.  He said I set the example by going over to Neuropa!  I don't buy that, but I can't think of any other reason why Stefan would do such a thing.

Recorded this 59th day of the 65th year of our Enlightenment

My next mission is another one where I have to retake "holy ground" from Mil-Agro.  The Theocracy frustrates me. Their only concerns are Hedoth sites and artifacts, and traitors to the faith.  They ignore our enemies until they trespass on a holy site.  Wars aren't won that way.

If I ever get the chance to get back.  I don't understand the High One.  He doesn't even care about the enemy.  All they want is alien knowledge to worship.

However, the moment the Neuropans entered one structure, the drones activated and destroyed the survey team .  Shortly thereafter, Mil-Agro forces entered the sector.  Mil-Agro's swift response implied they had prior knowledge of Neuropa's plans.
 
Counter-attack was imperative.  Jonus was to capture the Hedoth structures before Mil-Agro could.  Only once this task was completed would he and his staff be permitted to blast off.
Z_06\\MissionInfo.tbd.translated: Uma equipe Neuropa havia descoberto numerosas estruturas Hedoth cercadas por guardas inertes e incontaveis artefatos aliens.

Z_06\\MissionInfo.tbd.original:
GOALS
* Capture alien enhancers.
* Blast-off planet using the Matter Converter.
* Bonus given if mission accomplished within 90 minutes.
* Jonus and Komrov must survive.
Z_06\\MissionInfo.tbd.translated:
OBJETIVOS
* Capturar intens. aliens.
* Decolar com o MConverter.

Z_06\\MissionInfo.tbd.original: In spite of himself, Jonus grew fond of Komrov.  The Magister would regale him with tales from his youth, but he would avoid questions about his experiences after joining Neuropa.  He insisted the topic was too dangerous to discuss.  Mysteriously, he cautioned Jonus to not publicly defy the Theocracy, or they would arrange for him to serve them in death as a martyr.
Z_06\\MissionInfo.tbd.translated: Apesar de si mesmo, Jonus foi se encantando com Komrov. O Magistrado o entretinha com historias fascinantes da filosofia Neuropa.

Z_06\\MissionInfo.tbd.original:
BACKGROUND
* Railguns fire projectiles over great distances.
* Recon Pole Salvos recharge quickly and fire five terrain revealing imaging poles to any location on the surface.
* Point Defense System deflect railgun attacks with their protectors.

TECHNOLOGICAL ADVANCES
* Self Repair Torso
* Point Defense System
* Railgun Phase Charge Turret
* Railgun Recon Pole Salvo
Z_06\\MissionInfo.tbd.translated:
CONTEXTO
* Railguns disparam a longas distancias.
* Defesas Pontuais interceptam misseis.

Z_06\\MissionInfo.tbd.original:
Personal testament of Brother Jonus Angelus, of The Divine Order of Neuropa
Recorded this 56th day of the 65th year of our Enlightenment

My capture exposed me to a side of Rimtech I'd never seen before.  The interrogations were brutal...what I'd expect from Mil-Agro, not Rimtech.  If this is an indication of what Rimtech is becoming, I'm glad I left when I did!  I can't believe I'm actually relieved to be back.

To hear Neuropa tell it, I'll even fight my family to defend Neuropa and its beliefs.  Everyone around here keeps treating me like a hero.  Gullible fools.  It was Komrov who got us out of that prison and saved my life. First he escapes from the Mil-Agro prison during the Munich Uprising and now he escapes a Rimtech prison!  He's the real hero, and he's getting none of the credit.  I asked him if the lack of recognition bothers him, and he said he doesn't want any attention.  He's such a gentle man, I don't understand why he's with Neuropa at all, let alone having been with them long enough to become a Magister.

Recorded this 57th day of the 65th year of our Enlightenment

I can't sleep nights.  I keep thinking back to that screaming match I had with Diego in the prison.  Diego actually blamed me for Stefan going to over to Mil-Agro.  He said I set the example by going over to Neuropa!  I don't buy that, but I can't think of any other reason why Stefan would do such a thing.

Recorded this 59th day of the 65th year of our Enlightenment

My next mission is another one where I have to retake "holy ground" from Mil-Agro.  The Theocracy frustrates me. Their only concerns are Hedoth sites and artifacts, and traitors to the faith.  They ignore our enemies until they trespass on a holy site.  Wars aren't won that way.

If I ever get the chance to get back.  I don't understand the High One.  He doesn't even care about the enemy.  All they want is alien knowledge to worship.
Z_06\\MissionInfo.tbd.translated:
Testamento de Irmao Jonus Angelus, da Sagrada Ordem da Neuropa
Registrado neste dia da Iluminacao

Cada dia aqui e uma revelacao. A Neuropa possui conhecimentos que a Rimtech jamais sonhou. Komrov tem sido um guia paciente. Mas ha algo perturbador que ainda nao consigo definir.

Z_07\\gobjects.tbd.original:
Jonus had come to rely heavily on Komrov's experience and advice.  He was unprepared for the news that Komrov would not be joining him on his next mission.  Komrov would not explain why, but assured Jonus that he would do fine on his own.

When Neuropa's secret base at Aadham's Refuge was discovered by Rimtech, Neuropa went on immediate alert in anticipation of a large combot attack.  Jonus had fought in this sector before, and was sent to an orbital platform to hold the area.  Time was critical, and Jonus was promised a large bonus for quickly accomplishing the task.
Z_07\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Jonus havia passado a depender fortemente da experiencia de Komrov. Nao estava preparado para o que encontrou naquele dia.

Z_07\\gobjects.tbd.original:

* Bonus if mission accomplished within 60 minutes.
* Jonus must survive.
Z_07\\gobjects.tbd.translated:

* Vencer forcas inimigas.
* Bonus se concluido em 60 minutos.

Z_07\\gobjects.tbd.original: The technology advantage Neuropa had enjoyed at the start of the war had not been enough.  As the conflict escalated, all of the combatants merely exchanged grounds.  Furthermore, the growing sermons on spies led to a fanatical escalation of the Grand Inquisition and diverted attention from Neuropa's dwindling resources. The purge continued all around Jonus, and tensions in Neuropa remained high.
Z_07\\gobjects.tbd.translated: A vantagem tecnologica da Neuropa no inicio da guerra nao havia sido suficiente para compensar suas graves desvantagens estrategicas.

Z_07\\gobjects.tbd.original:
Personal testament of Brother Jonus Angelus, of The Divine Order of Neuropa
Recorded this 79th day of the 65th year of our Enlightenment

Rumor has it that the Theocracy has started some kind of Inquisition to uncover traitors in our midst. It's ridiculous and must be an excuse to purge the ranks of malcontents. There's no way any spy could infiltrate this bunch of fanatics. 

Recorded this 83rd day of the 65th year of our Enlightenment

Komrov is off on some secret project.  Given his Magister position, I bet Komrov's part of the Inquisition.  I've never been a believer, so I wonder how long it'll be before they come after me?  Komrov warned me they'd use any excuse to kill me if it served their purposes. I just hope Komrov can shield me from the them.  

Recorded this 84th day of the 65th year of our Enlightenment 

Is it my imagination or is everyone watching me?  This is crazy.  I've got to find a way out of this mess.
