Z_08\\gobjects.tbd.original:
With its resources waning and its enemies encroaching on Hedoth sites, unrest spread through some Neuropa sects, and the Theocracy feared a dangerous dissention.  A dramatic and profitable victory was required to reunite the sects and boost Neuropa's fortunes.

Jonus was sent to Ice Sanctuary, which had become the most fiercely contested territory of the war.  Rimtech had taken control, but Mil-Agro maintained a fighting presence there. This was hallowed Neuropa territory and Jonus's task was to completely retake the sector from the enemy.  The need for resources took precedence, thus a bonus would be awarded for salvaged enemy structures.  Komrov returned to aid Jonus in what would prove to be their final mission together.
Z_08\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Com seus recursos diminuindo e seus inimigos avancando sobre os locais Hedoth, a agitacao se espalhava por toda a Neuropa.

Z_08\\gobjects.tbd.original:
GOALS
* Vanquish the enemy forces.
* Jonus and Komrov must survive.
* Bonus for remaining enemy structures.
Z_08\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
OBJETIVOS
* Vencer forcas inim.
* Jonus e Komrov sobrevivam.
* Bonus permanencia.

Z_08\\gobjects.tbd.original: Jonus achieved the decisive victory he sought at Ice Sanctuary.  As hoped for, he was indeed proclaimed again to be a hero to the masses and promoted the rank of Vice Commander.  But, just as Jonus began to plan his escape from Neuropa, he also was summoned before the Grand Inquisition and the Theocracy itself.
Z_08\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Jonus alcancou a vitoria decisiva no Santuario de Gelo. Como esperado, encontrou Komrov e o confrontou pessoalmente.

Z_08\\gobjects.tbd.original:
Personal testament of Brother Jonus Angelus, of The Divine Order of Neuropa
Recorded this 91st day of the 65th year of our Enlightenment

We're headed for Ice Santuary. It was one of the first Neuropan territories to be established before the war started.  Now all three Corpos have been fighting for it for weeks.  My job is to take it for Neuropa, once and for all, and give the Theocracy propaganda machine a big boost. Fortunately, Komrov is back to help me.  He won't tell me where he's been or what he's been doing.  

My plan is to win such a decisive victory at Ice Sanctuary that Neuropa will again tout me as a hero. That should clear me of any suspicion of being a spy.  And this time I won't resist being their propaganda tool.  I'll ask Komrov recommend that I be shipped back to the Core Systems for recruiting purposes.  Once there, I'll grab a berth on an Earth bound ship and find a new corporation.  With my skills, I'll have corponations at my feet begging me to join them.

Sector 4 is the hot spot of the Corponation war.  Everyone is fighting for it.  If I can take it, maybe they'll stop suspecting us.  <getting sick of Neuropa>

Z_09\\gobjects.tbd.original:
Upheavals in the Cob family of Mil-Agro had resulted in a list of Mil-Agro spies being released to Neuropa.  Komrov was the most influential name on the list.  Komrov had provided Mil-Agro with Neuropan secrets for years, including the latest Orbital Weapons technology.  He was a traitorous heretic, but had fled before the Inquisitors could arrest him.

The Theocracy informed Jonus that only he was best suited to stop Komrov from escaping.  Feeling betrayed by the man he had come to trust as a friend, Jonus declared he would kill Komrov on the condition that he would be allowed to leave Neuropa and return to Earth.  To his surprise, they agreed.
Z_09\\gobjects.tbd.translated: As agitacoes na familia Cob resultaram na exposicao de uma longa lista de espioes Mil-Agro, desencadeando uma onda de retaliacao.

Z_09\\gobjects.tbd.original:
GOALS
* Vanquish Komrov before he escapes.  You have 60 minutes.
* Jonus must survive.
Z_09\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
OBJETIVOS
* Vencer Komrov antes que escape. 60 min.
* Jonus sobreviva

Z_09\\gobjects.tbd.original:
Jonus was successful in his mission.  Magister Komrov was dead.

Upon his return to base, Jonus learned of the Mil-Agro rebellion, and how the Cobs had used mind control on its subjects, including people like Stefan.  It was now clear to him that Komrov had not intentionally betrayed anyone -- Mil-Agro controlled him.

Horrified by his actions, Jonus demanded the release he had been promised.  He was assured it would happen soon, but for now they needed just a few more missions from him.
Z_09\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
Jonus teve sucesso em sua missao. O Magistrado Komrov estava morto.

Ao retornar, Jonus descobriu que sua posicao na Neuropa havia mudado drasticamente.

TECHNOLOGICAL ADVANCES
* Sniper Laser Arm
* Railgun Tectonic Torpedo Turret
* Railgun Orbital Bomb Turret
Z_09\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
CONTEXTO
* O Braco Laser Sniper e a arma Neuropa de longo alcance mais avancada.

Z_09\\gobjects.tbd.original:
Personal testament of Brother Jonus Angelus, of The Divine Order of Neuropa
Recorded this 104th day of the 65th year of our Enlightenment

Komrov was the spy!  How could I have missed this?!  He didn't escape from Mil-Agro during the Munich 15040 Uprising, they let him go!  I'll bet it's no coincidence that Mil-Agro attacked the Rimtech prison we were in.  They were protecting Komrov!  He only brought me along to make it look less suspicious than if he alone had escaped!

I've been ordered to kill him, and why not?  I don't care that he's betrayed Neuropa, but he used me.  I want out, and if taking out Komrov will buy my freedom, so be it.

Z_10\\gobjects.tbd.original:
As the war entered its final stages, Hedoth Prime had fallen to Rimtech, and Hedoth II to Mil-Agro.  To achieve parity, Neuropa had to conquer Hedoth III.  The Relus Hesidu region was selected as the key to conquering the planet.
 
Jonus and his staff would be secretly inserted into Relus Hesidu.  The first objective was to reach an abandoned base in the northwest region.  After that, he was to vanquish all foes in the sector.

Jonus left for this mission a changed man.  He had betrayed his family and killed his only friend.  He would complete the mission for Neuropa, but vowed to make up for his past actions.
Z_10\\gobjects.tbd.translated: Ao entrar nas etapas finais da guerra, Hedoth Prime havia caido para a Rimtech. O destino das outras colonias Hedoth estava em jogo.

Z_10\\gobjects.tbd.original:

* Vanquish enemy forces.
* Jonus must survive.
Z_10\\gobjects.tbd.translated:
OBJETIVOS

* Vencer forcas inim.
* Jonus sobreviva

Z_10\\gobjects.tbd.original:
Personal testament of Brother Jonus Angelus, of The Divine Order of Neuropa
Recorded this 109th day of the 65th year of our Enlightenment

I've been a fool.  They'll never let me go.  Death is the only escape from Neuropa.

I thought I was using Neuropa, but they've been using me.  I'm a puppet.  They've manipulated me, all the while making me think I was using them.  God, I may even be responsible for this whole war.  What was I thinking, bringing that arm to Neuropa?  I've betrayed everyone, and what has it gotten me?  I've lost my brothers, my home at Rimtech, and I've killed my only friend.

It's too late for me to do anything about Komrov -- I'll live with that guilt for the rest of my life -- but perhaps one day I can make amends with my brothers for all the grief I've caused.

Jonus left for this mission a changed man.  He had betrayed his family and killed his only friend.  He would complete the mission for Neuropa, but vowed to make up for his past actions.

Personal testament of Brother Jonus Angelus, of The Divine Order of Neuropa
Recorded this 109th day of the 65th year of our Enlightenment

I've been a fool.  They'll never let me go.  Death is the only escape from Neuropa.

I thought I was using Neuropa, but they've been using me.  I'm a puppet.  They've manipulated me, all the while making me think I was using them.  God, I may even be responsible for this whole war.  What was I thinking, bringing that arm to Neuropa?  I've betrayed everyone, and what has it gotten me?  I've lost my brothers, my home at Rimtech, and I've killed my only friend.

It's too late for me to do anything about Komrov -- I'll live with that guilt for the rest of my life -- but perhaps one day I can make amends with my brothers for all the grief I've caused.
